name: Benji S.
about: I run the AI Builders Club. I write what we should build, direct the AI that builds it, and playtest everything.

projects.title: Hop Bot
projects.summary: A robot sky-hopping game for our Club Rush table: solo, race Byte the AI, or two players. Party Mode races a whole room on their phones. Built with Claude.

projects.title: Teach It
projects.summary: Paint two groups of dots and watch a small neural network learn to separate them, live in your browser. Built with Claude Code.
